headline: Good morning — the RBA's fifth hike of 2026 is deepening the housing slump, while Adobe and Salesforce push agentic AI further into marketing and government.

highlights.label: Housing slump
highlights.text: Cotality's national home values fell 1.2% in October, a seventh straight monthly drop, after the RBA lifted the cash rate to 4.85%.

highlights.label: Adobe agents
highlights.text: Adobe made its CX Enterprise Coworker available inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot, taking marketing agents into third-party assistants.

highlights.label: Salesforce deals
highlights.text: Salesforce has reportedly agreed to buy Cresta and Rune Technologies, and its Missionforce unit gained Pentagon marketplace status.

tip.title: Do a five-minute wind-down
tip.body: Set a reminder 30 to 60 minutes before bed to dim the lights and put work devices away. Use the time for something calming, such as stretching, a shower or reading. A consistent wind-down cue helps the body shift towards sleep.

quote.text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
quote.author: Mark Twain

items.title: Adobe puts its CX agent inside ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Copilot
items.summary: Adobe announced on 4 November that its CX Enterprise Coworker can be used inside several third-party AI assistants, with more integrations listed as coming soon. Pricing and data-handling details were not disclosed, and some integrations are Adobe-stated only.

items.title: 6sense rebrands around agentic go-to-market
items.summary: At its Breakthrough 2026 conference on 3 November, 6sense repositioned itself around agentic go-to-market, with a BDR Agent entering beta this month. It shows B2B platforms racing to productise AI agents for sales and marketing.

items.title: Yext closes acquisition of Flamel.ai
items.summary: Yext reportedly completed its purchase of Flamel.ai on 2 November. Consolidation continues as vendors buy AI capability to stay visible in AI-generated answers.

items.title: Smartly launches forecasting and incrementality product
items.summary: Smartly released a product on 2 November that combines forecasting tools with an incrementality measurement layer. It targets advertisers wanting clearer proof of what paid media actually drives.

items.title: Survey: many US shoppers plan to use AI assistants this holiday season
items.summary: A Talkdesk survey published on 4 November found a large share of US shoppers intend to use AI assistants during the holidays. Marketers may need to plan for product discovery happening inside assistants rather than on their own sites.

items.title: Salesforce's Missionforce unit gains Pentagon marketplace status
items.summary: Missionforce National Security achieved 'Awardable' status for its recruiting capabilities in the CDAO's Tradewinds marketplace on 10 November. It eases the path for defence agencies to buy Salesforce tools.

items.title: Salesforce agrees to acquire Cresta
items.summary: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement to acquire Cresta on 2 November, according to its newsroom. Closing status is unclear, as one tracker reports the deal as closed; not independently confirmed.

items.title: Rune Technologies purchase and new Koa Decisions model
items.summary: Salesforce Ben reports the Rune Technologies acquisition as Salesforce's largest national security purchase so far, alongside a new Koa Decisions AI model on 9 November. Together they signal a push into defence and decision-focused AI.

items.title: Agentforce Coworker usage up 21x in three months
items.summary: Salesforce said on 3 November that use of its Agentforce Coworker has grown 21-fold over three months. The figure is company-reported and not independently verified.

items.title: Salesforce adds Quick Pages for custom page building
items.summary: Salesforce Ben reported on 6 November that Quick Pages lets teams build custom pages more simply. It is a small but practical update for admins.

sfstatus.statusNote: No major Salesforce incident was found for the last 48 hours, but live Trust status pages could not be checked directly.

items.title: RBA lifts cash rate to 4.85%
items.summary: The RBA raised the cash rate by 25 basis points on 3 November, the fifth rise of 2026, with a 6–3 vote. Cotality expects it to weaken housing further, with the next decision due 8 December.

items.title: Home values fall for a seventh straight month
items.summary: Cotality's national index fell 1.2% in October, leaving values 6.7% below the March peak. Annual values are down 2.8%.

items.title: Borrowing power shrinks after rate hike
items.summary: Cotality says the latest hike cuts borrowing capacity and weakens serviceability and sentiment. That limits what buyers can pay and adds to downward price pressure.

items.title: Listings hit a five-year high as homes sell slowly
items.summary: Stock on the market has reached a five-year high while homes take longer to sell. More supply against weak demand favours buyers.

items.title: Rate hike hits the auction market
items.summary: MacroBusiness reports auction results fell sharply after the RBA's rate rise. Weak clearance rates have historically pointed to softer prices.
